_comment: HikePOS (hikeup.com) — the second POS. Albert, 2026-10-07: a Hike product export for Floors at Work products, to be updated from Airtable (existing rows) and extended with Airtable's new products. Read by scripts/hike_update.py; method methods/hike-pos.md. Hike has no product id: the SKU IS the identity, and Hike's own help says editing a product's SKU OR its Product Name in an import creates a NEW product. So an existing row keeps both, exactly as exported.
_outlet_note: Per-outlet columns are '<outlet>_Cost price', '<outlet>_Retail price' and so on. One outlet in the 2026-10-07 export.
_never_change_note: Hike help, 'How to Bulk Edit Product Information in Hike': 'Do not edit anything relating to your SKU or Product Name, as this will create a new product entry once you import it back into Hike.' Barcode equals SKU on every exported row, so it is left alone too.
_never_touch_note: Stock and average cost are Hike's own running numbers; the file carries them exactly as exported. Import soon after exporting, or re-export and re-run first: a sale made in between would be undone by re-importing the older stock figure.

FAW._markup_note: Albert, 2026-10-07: Hike keeps its own +$1.40 over cost (161 of 170 matched rows already sat at it), on the Airtable cost. NOT Airtable's Retail (cost + $1.00). Applies to per-sq-ft flooring only; an accessory keeps its own existing markup.
FAW._promo_floor_note: Hike descriptions end 'Promotion: $ / N=70c'. On every flooring row N = cost + 0.70 (199 of 199 checked), the lowest promo price at a 70c margin. Rewritten with the new cost only where the old N was old cost + 0.70; mouldings and stair sets carry a different N and are left alone.
FAW._colour_aliases_note: Hike spelling -> Airtable SKU, each checked by eye on 2026-10-07: Bemuda = Regal Bermuda 23.31; Russel Hill = Aquaplus Gold Russell Hill; 'Thomas' is the Aquawood 10mm 29.92sf/b colour Airtable spells Thames.
FAW._manual_matches_note: Hike rows whose names do not follow the '(Colour) Click |' pattern, read one by one on 2026-10-07: 100332 'FAWENG - GOLDEN - Click 29.28sf/b' = White Oak Click Golden; 100308 'OREGON OAK T&G 6.5in 19.74' = White Oak Oregon Oak; 100333 THAMES and 100340 VOLGA 10mm = Aquawood; 100335 'FAWLAM Aecon 3mm 34.58' is the Aqua Commercial vinyl Aecon despite the LAM label; 100337 / '100337 - copy' = Waterproof Laminate Pro Urban Walnut / Heritage Maple; FAW.V.7V.Tob.7 says 183mm = the 183mm Tobermory record (box 15); FAW.V.ST.RETURN = the Step + Riser + Side Return set at $49.
FAW._exclude_new_note: Oak stair treads and risers: Titan does not carry them (Albert, 2026-09-20), so they are never added to Hike either. Inactive Airtable records are never added.
